theme: One noon call, an open day, Croatia prep still on the clock.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. Just the Valoris call at noon anchors today, and the rest is yours. A single St Pete errand run can retire several Croatia to-dos in one trip.

needsAttention.title: Deck shoes before Croatia
needsAttention.detail: The Helly Hansen order was cancelled, so both non-marking pairs (Mike 11, Dan 9.5) still need buying in person in St Pete. The online backup closes today if the store trip falls through.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 19 Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter, over by Dubrovnik airport, has been open since Aug 23. It has to be booked before you sail Sept 8, when connectivity drops.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Croatia checked bags
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags, and two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on. Verify the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site and buy bags now if needed.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing-gap lodging
needsAttention.detail: The two nights (Sept 20-21) between the TPA landing and Tuesday's kid pickup still aren't booked, overdue since Aug 25.

flagged.title: Conor Kehoe intro was recalled
flagged.detail: Conor Kehoe's office recalled Eugenia Jackson's PGIM introduction this morning, on the PRI networking thread you'd already replied to.

inbox.noise: Promos from Qatar Airways, Breeze, and a yard-service pitch.
inbox.clear: Nothing else is awaiting your reply.

recipe.title: Chambery Trout
recipe.why: A light summer supper for the season's peak of fresh fish and herbs.

tasks.title: Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip
St Pete supplies run, shampoo and hand soap

acts.line: A clear morning with nothing booked before noon, the real working block of the day.
Martin Steindl from Valoris on Teams, the day's only fixed point.
No evening commitments; the girls are home with you and Mike in St Pete.
